_about: Conditions to report IMMEDIATELY under Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (IDSR). Based on WHO AFRO's IDSR technical guidelines (3rd edition); Ghana's own IDSR guidelines (Ministry of Health, 2022) must be checked by the district before the pilot. Each rule needs ALL of its 'all' groups to match (any one pattern per group). This is a prompt to report, not a diagnosis.

diseases.name: acute flaccid paralysis (possible polio)
diseases.action: Report every case in a child under 15 immediately. Two stool samples are needed within 14 days of onset: ask the district how to collect them.

diseases.name: measles
diseases.action: Keep the child away from other children and pregnant women. Check the vaccination card. The district may send a team to collect a sample.

diseases.name: cholera
diseases.action: Start ORS at once and send the person to a facility. Advise the household on boiling water and handwashing. Report even one case.

diseases.name: meningitis
diseases.action: Refer to a facility now. Several cases in one community in a week may be an outbreak: say how many in your report.

diseases.name: yellow fever
diseases.action: Refer to a facility. Check the yellow fever vaccination status of the person and their household.

diseases.name: viral haemorrhagic fever (Ebola, Marburg or Lassa)
diseases.action: Do not touch the person's body fluids. Keep others away. Call the district now; do not move the person without advice.

diseases.name: neonatal tetanus
diseases.action: Refer to a facility now. Report every case.

diseases.name: suspected rabies
diseases.action: Wash the wound with soap and running water for 15 minutes and send the person to a facility today for assessment.

diseases.name: mpox
diseases.action: Keep the person away from others and avoid touching the sores. Refer to a facility.

diseases.name: anthrax
diseases.action: Advise people not to handle or eat meat from animals that died suddenly. Tell the district and the veterinary officer.

diseases.name: maternal death
diseases.action: Every maternal death is reported within 24 hours for a review.

diseases.name: unusual cluster of illness or deaths
diseases.action: Several people with the same illness in a short time is reported immediately, even before the cause is known.
